The official Youtube channel for our class leading equine dentistry veterinary clinic in Dorset, England. EDC is a world renowned specialist horse dentistry clinic, led by EBVS/RCVS Recognised Specialists Chris Pearce MRCVS, Nicole du Toit MRCVS, and Richard Reardon MRCVS. 

We are the world's most advanced specialist equine dental referral centre, providing expert care for horses of all ages and breeds. Our team of world-renowned veterinary surgeons and equine dental technicians offer cutting-edge treatments, including advanced dental imaging, surgical procedures, and preventive care. Whether you're a veterinarian, equine dental technician, or horse owner, we're committed to providing the highest quality dental care for your equine companions.
